49ers vs Seahawks Betting History

The San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks have met 57 times since the 1976 season. The Seahawks lead the series 33-24. Against the closing spread the 49ers are 24-32-1 (Seahawks 32-24-1), and the over is 26-27-3 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Jan 17, 2026, Seahawks 41-6.
